issues.t: ABS module can short and cause an engine bay fire (recall)
issues.sym: ABS or brake warning lights, or a burning smell or smoke from under the hood, even when the car is parked and off.
issues.why: The ABS hydraulic control unit can develop an internal short circuit. Kia recalled these cars to install a lower-rated fuse and told owners to park outside until repaired.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 23V-652. Until it is fixed, park outside and away from buildings, and stop driving immediately if you see smoke.

issues.t: Airbags may not deploy in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: Often no symptom; an airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: The airbag control unit can short during a crash and stop the front airbags and seat belt pretensioners from working. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-363 and have it repaired soon.

issues.sym: Brake lights do not come on, cruise control will not switch off, or the shifter will not leave Park.
issues.why: A faulty stop lamp switch can stop the brake lights and related features from working. Kia recalled many models for this.
issues.next: Have someone check your brake lights and check your VIN for recall 13V-114.

issues.sym: Red fluid under the front of the car, slipping, or the car losing the ability to move.
issues.why: A transmission fluid cooler hose can leak until the transmission runs low and stops driving the car. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Do not drive if fluid is leaking or the car will not move properly. Check your VIN for recall 16V-070.

issues.t: Theft risk on key-start models without immobilizer
issues.sym: Broken steering column trim, a damaged ignition, or the car being stolen.
issues.why: Key-start Fortes without a factory immobilizer were targeted by a widely shared theft method. Kia offers a free software upgrade for eligible cars.
issues.next: Have a Kia dealer check whether your VIN qualifies for the free anti-theft upgrade, and consider a steering wheel lock.

issues.t: Brake lights stay on and shifter leaves Park without brake (recall)
issues.sym: Brake lights stay lit when you are not braking, cruise control will not set, or the shifter moves out of Park without pressing the brake.
issues.why: A small rubber stopper pad at the brake pedal can crumble, so the brake light switch stays on. Kia recalled cars to replace the pad.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 17V-773. It is a quick dealer fix, and stuck brake lights can confuse drivers behind you.

issues.t: Engine damage and engine bay fire (recall)
issues.sym: A knocking sound from the engine, low oil, check engine light, reduced power, or smoke and oil smell from under the hood.
issues.why: Engine damage such as bearing wear can lead to oil leaks and, in some cases, a fire while driving. Kia recalled these cars for an engine inspection and a knock-sensor software update.
issues.next: Stop driving if the engine knocks or you smell burning oil. Have a Kia dealer check your VIN for recall 20V-750, ask about any extended engine coverage, and keep oil-change records.

issues.t: Front seat belt retractor screws may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no symptom; sometimes a rattle near the seat belt retractor.
issues.why: Screws holding the front seat belt retractor plate may not be tight, so the plate could break in a crash. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 16V-312 and have it fixed.

issues.t: Cooling fan resistor can overheat and melt (recall)
issues.sym: A hot plastic or burning smell from the front of the engine bay, or the cooling fan not working right.
issues.why: The resistor that controls the radiator fan speed can overheat and melt, creating a fire risk. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Stop and shut off the engine if you smell burning. Check your VIN for recall 15V-015.

issues.t: Trunk cannot be opened from inside (recall)
issues.sym: The inside emergency trunk release does not open the lid.
issues.why: The trunk latch can be damaged so the inside release does not work. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-622 and have the latch replaced.

issues.t: Oil pump can fail from debris (recall)
issues.sym: Oil pressure warning light, engine knocking, or loss of power.
issues.why: Bits of debris can jam the oil pump, cutting oil flow and damaging the engine. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 21V-260. If the oil pressure light comes on, pull over and shut the engine off right away.

issues.sym: Often no symptom; an airbag warning light may come on.
issues.why: The cover of the airbag control unit can damage a circuit inside it, so the airbags may not deploy in a crash. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-031 and have it repaired soon.

issues.t: Left front axle shaft may break (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or vibration from the front left, then a sudden loss of drive power.
issues.why: Some left front axle shafts were not heat-treated properly and can break. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 20V-459 and have it repaired before driving far.

issues.t: LED headlight low beams may be aimed wrong (recall)
issues.sym: Poor night visibility or oncoming drivers flashing their lights at you.
issues.why: Some LED headlights had the low beam aimed incorrectly. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 18V-771 and have the headlights corrected.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may not switch off for a child seat (recall)
issues.sym: The passenger airbag indicator shows on with a child seat in the front seat.
issues.why: The passenger occupant sensor may fail to detect a child seat, leaving the airbag active. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Keep children in the back seat and check your VIN for recall 21V-164.

issues.t: Steering column joint bolt may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or play in the steering wheel, or the wheel not turning the front wheels normally.
issues.why: A bolt at the lower steering column joint may not be tight, so the column could separate from the steering rack. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Stop driving if the steering feels loose. Check your VIN for recall 22V-304.

issues.t: Front lower control arm weld defect (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front right suspension, loose steering, or the car pulling or wandering.
issues.why: Some cars were built with a poorly welded right front lower control arm that can fail. Kia recalled them and advised not driving until repaired.
issues.next: Do not drive the car until a dealer confirms recalls 23V-649 and 24V-244 are done.

issues.sym: Clunking from the front left, loose or vague steering, or the car pulling.
issues.why: The front left steering knuckle may crack, which can cause loss of steering control. Kia recalled affected cars.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 22V-906 right away and avoid driving until it is inspected.
